content.title: About
content.content: Cheez‑It crackers are small square-shaped snack crackers with a pronounced cheese flavor, made from wheat flour, vegetable oil and cheese. They are known for their crunchy texture and a light, slightly salty aroma. The product is popular as a quick snack and is often found in school lunch boxes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Cheez‑It first appeared in the United States in 1921 under the Sunshine Biscuits brand.
The distinctive "plus‑plus" square‑hole shape was designed for easy biting.
The original recipe uses cheddar cheese, but today there are versions with other cheeses and spices.
The Cheez‑It brand has been owned by Kellogg Company since 2001.
In the 2020s the company released limited‑edition flavors such as "chipotle" and "spicy jalapeño".

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The cheese component provides a modest amount of calcium, beneficial for bone health.

items.title: Contains vitamin B12
items.content: Vitamin B12 present in the cheese is important for the nervous system and red blood cell formation.

items.title: Quick energy source
items.content: Crackers deliver fast‑acting energy from carbohydrates, convenient during active days.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: The amount of salt may be undesirable for individuals with hypertension.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The product contains dairy cheese, which can trigger reactions in people allergic to milk.

items.title: Calorie dense
items.content: Because of carbs and fats, portion sizes should be moderated to avoid excess calorie intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cheez‑It crackers are convenient to eat straight from the bag, add to soups, salads, or snack platters. They can be crushed and sprinkled over casseroles or used in recipes to add a crunchy texture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place with the package tightly sealed. For longer storage keep in an airtight container to prevent moisture absorption, which makes the crackers soft.
